name: Matcha Cookies
directions: Line parchment paper on a 12 x 17 in pan
Mix all the dry ingredients in a small bowl
Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy. First add half the sugar, whisk, then add the other half
Mix rest of the wet ingredients with the butter-sugar cream
Slowly add dry mixture in with wet mixture ~ 1/3 at a time
Fold the flour and wet ingredients with a SPATULA (Don't overmix, dough should be slightly sticky)
Optional: Fold in white chocolate chips
With an ice cream scoop ~1 TBSP, scoop and shape dough into small circles and place 2in apart from each other
Optional: For frog faces, get 1 TBSP for the face and 1/4 tsp for each ear and roll into balls and place in a mickey mouse shape
Place Cookies in oven for 10-13 minutes and poke with toothpick, if clean, pull out of oven
Transfer onto baking rack or just off pan to cool for 10 minutes
Optional: for frog faces, melt dark chocolate and use piping bag to decorate
